priority.reduce_emi_20.title: Reduce monthly EMI burden by 20%
priority.reduce_emi_20.why: Your current debt servicing ratio is elevating default risk. Trimming obligations will ease cash flow.
priority.reduce_emi_20.action: Explore debt consolidation, prepay high-interest short-term loans, or restructure existing loan tenures.
priority.reduce_emi_30.title: Aggressively reduce monthly EMIs by 30%
priority.reduce_emi_30.why: High debt commitments consume a significant share of your earnings, limiting financial resilience.
priority.reduce_emi_30.action: Liquidate non-yielding assets to prepay costliest loans, or negotiate balance transfer to lower interest rates.
priority.raise_emergency_fund_3m.title: Build a 3-month emergency safety fund
priority.raise_emergency_fund_3m.why: Your liquid runway is under 3 months, leaving you vulnerable to sudden financial shocks.
priority.raise_emergency_fund_3m.action: Direct monthly surplus into an auto-sweep deposit or high-yield liquid mutual fund until 3 months of expenses are secured.
priority.raise_emergency_fund_6m.title: Expand emergency reserve to 6 months of expenses
priority.raise_emergency_fund_6m.why: A 6-month buffer safeguards your debt servicing capacity against job transitions or medical emergencies.
priority.raise_emergency_fund_6m.action: Allocate seasonal bonuses and tax refunds to lock in an untouchable 6-month living reserve.
priority.reduce_expenditure_10.title: Cut discretionary monthly expenditure by 10%
priority.reduce_expenditure_10.why: Tight monthly surpluses can quickly lead to distress when unexpected expenses arise.
priority.reduce_expenditure_10.action: Audit recurring subscription charges and discretionary lifestyle spends to redirect savings towards debt reduction.
priority.improve_credit_history.title: Maintain pristine repayment discipline for 12 months
priority.improve_credit_history.why: Recent delays or irregular repayment severely suppresses your credit profile and score.
priority.improve_credit_history.action: Automate auto-debit for all credit card and EMI payments at least 3 business days before due dates.
priority.clear_default.title: Resolve and cure past defaulted obligations
priority.clear_default.why: A recorded default is the single heaviest downward pull on credit risk evaluations.
priority.clear_default.action: Approach the lending institution for a formal settlement/closure letter and update your bureau records.
roadmap.3m.title: Immediate Stabilization (Months 1–3)
roadmap.3m.detail: Automate all bills, audit living costs, cut non-essential recurring spends by 10%, and begin building a liquid emergency cushion.
roadmap.6m.title: Debt Consolidation & Runway (Months 4–6)
roadmap.6m.detail: Aim to prepay or restructure the highest interest loan to lower monthly EMI, and attain at least 3 months of liquid living reserves.
roadmap.12m.title: Long-term Score Acceleration (Months 7–12)
roadmap.12m.detail: Solidify 12 consecutive months of flawless repayment history, expand emergency fund to 6 months, and check bureau records for discrepancies.
habit.emi_ceiling.title: The 40% EMI Ceiling Rule
habit.emi_ceiling.detail: Never allow total monthly EMI obligations to exceed 40% of your take-home income.
habit.emergency_buffer.title: Guarded Emergency Runway
habit.emergency_buffer.detail: Keep at least 3 to 6 months of basic living expenses in an instant-access account, untouched except for true emergencies.
habit.auto_pay.title: 100% Automated Bill Discipline
habit.auto_pay.detail: Set up auto-debit for credit cards and loans 3 days before payment due dates to prevent unintentional score damage.
habit.credit_utilization.title: Credit Utilization Below 30%
habit.credit_utilization.detail: Keep credit card balance utilization strictly below 30% of your sanctioned credit limit across all cards.
habit.annual_check.title: Annual Bureau Audit
habit.annual_check.detail: Check your official credit report annually to rectify administrative reporting errors or fraudulent accounts early.
habit.scheme_leverage.title: Maximize Welfare & Subsidy Entitlements
habit.scheme_leverage.detail: Leverage applicable central and state government interest subventions, insurance coverages, and skill subsidies.
